provenance.notes: The concept list, the English and Arabic names and the candidate icon names are authored (tools/extract/icons/core-set.input.txt). The script keeps a source name only when it exists in that source catalog (deprecated icons excluded), so every name under `sources` is verified to exist; that it depicts the same concept is the author's judgement and was not checked visually. A source missing from `sources` means no candidate matched, not proof that the set lacks the concept. Arabic names were written by the author, not taken from an authoritative Arabic source: needs review by an Arabic-speaking designer. `mirror` is the verdict of the linked rule in mirror-rules.json, or an explicit override where the concept is one fixed case of a conditional rule.
